name: Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells iron and steel, coke, and coke-by products in Turkey. The company also engages in steel structure manufacturing and assembly; casting and machining; energy business; and intra-city and intercity freight transportation activities. Kardemir Karabük Demir Çelik Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Karabük, Turkey.
